lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Morning. Let's keep it quick, I know everyone's got a lot this week. Angela, you want to start with the beta?

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Sure. So, Balcony App 3.0 beta. We're at forty-one testers as of this morning. Two more signed up over the weekend.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Nice. And how's it holding up?

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Mostly good. We've got two crash reports, both on older Android. Same kind of device, both on Android 11, both crash when they open the camera from an inspection.

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: I saw those. I think it's the photo side, but I haven't dug in yet. I'll grab it.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Is it every Android 11 device, or just those two?

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Just those two so far. We've got maybe six testers on Android 11, and the other four haven't hit it. Could be they just haven't opened the camera enough.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Thanks, Tybalt. What else?

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: The other one's the offline-sync bug Balthasar found. If you edit the same inspection on two devices while you're offline, and then both come back online, one of the edits just, um, quietly loses.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Quietly loses. That's the worst kind.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Yeah. He's got clean repro steps, so at least it's not a ghost. He's still on it, and he thinks it's in how we merge the two versions when they come back.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Okay. That one I care about. Offline is the whole point of the release.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Agreed. So, I've got the release checklist. I'll own it. And I'd like to put the go or no-go on the calendar for Friday at nine thirty, if that works for both of you.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Friday nine thirty works for me.

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: Works.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Great. I'll send the invite after this.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Tybalt, anything from you?

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: One thing, and I know it's not really beta stuff. Schema Bridge. The kickoff's today, right?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Three o'clock, yeah.

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: So my worry is, if the bridge depends on Montague's Mesh Routing being up, then our inspectors depend on it being up. And we don't control their uptime. If their service goes down at, like, two in the morning, does Balcony just stop working?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: That's fair. I don't think it should, but I don't actually know what they're planning.

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: Right. I'm not saying don't do it. I just don't want to find out the hard way that our app has a new single point of failure that lives in somebody else's building.

lines.speaker: nurse_angela
lines.text: Can I add one thing? Whatever the answer is, I'd want it written down before anything goes near a customer.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Yep. Okay, let's raise it with Romeo in the kickoff. I'll put it on the agenda, first thing after scope, and I'll tell you both what he says.

lines.speaker: tybalt_capulet
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Anything else? No? Okay. Thanks, everyone. Good week, let's go.
